adds.title: X2
adds.text: Inside the Alkali Lake dam, a brainwashed Scott aims a blast at Magneto and Mystique from a crossing hallway. Jean shoves them clear and tells them to go, and Magneto leaves her to fight Scott.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scott, under Stryker's control, aims a blast at him in the dam.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Aims a blast at Magneto in the dam while under Stryker's control.
adds.evidence: X2: at Stryker's Alkali Lake base, the mind-controlled Cyclops prepares to shoot at Magneto and Mystique; Jean telekinetically shoves them out of the way and tells them to go, and Magneto calls it a lovers' quarrel they cannot get involved in. (Earlier Scott only waits outside the plastic prison while Xavier questions Magneto, so the dam is the moment between them.)
